samples.xml_description:
<module id="sequence_detector">
    <description>Detects a specific 4-bit binary sequence 1001 using a finite state machine.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal to synchronize the detector.</input>
        <input id="reset_n">Active-low reset signal to initialize the state machine.</input>
        <input id="data_in">1-bit binary input signal to feed the bitstream for sequence detection.</input>
        <output id="sequence_detected">1-bit output signal that is set high when the specific sequence is detected.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>IDLE</parameter>
        <parameter>S1</parameter>
        <parameter>S2</parameter>
        <parameter>S3</parameter>
        <parameter>S4</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state">The current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state">The next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <wire id="match_s1">Signal indicating a match in state S1.</wire>
        <wire id="match_s2">Signal indicating a match in state S2.</wire>
        <wire id="match_s3">Signal indicating a match in state S3.</wire>
        <wire id="match_s4">Signal indicating a match in state S4.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
            if (!reset_n) begin
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        end

        // Next state logic
        always @(*) begin
            case (current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                S1: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                S2: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                S3: begin
                    if (data_in == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                S4: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end

        // Output logic
        always @(*) begin
            sequence_detected = (current_state == S4);
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
